name: Asphalt 8 Vita
description: Native compatibility port of Asphalt 8 Android v2.0.0e for PlayStation Vita. Data-free; users supply exact game files.
long_description:
A port of the Android version of Asphalt 8 v2.0.0e for PS Vita
It uses the original ARMv7 Android game library, with so_util, FalsoJNI and VitaGL.
Races, menus, saving, physical controls and touch are working
Performance runs in the high 50s during races

- PsVitaAlive -
requirements: - Homebrew enabled PS Vita with VitaShell - kubridge.skprx installed - libshacccg.suprx at ur0:/data/libshacccg.suprx or ur0:/data/external/libshacccg.suprx - Your own Asphalt 8 v2.0.0e APK and OBB
